comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your environment

zuul.comment: Zuul CI server configuration. pipelines: which pipelines to monitor for failures. hours_back: how many hours back to look for failures.

gerrit.comment: Gerrit server configuration. Usually does not need to change for OpenStack.

output.comment: Where to save CI failure analysis reports. Supports ~ for home directory.

monitoring.comment: Settings for automated monitoring. max_changes_per_cycle limits processing per run.

filters.comment: skip_non_voting: if true, only analyze voting jobs. Non-voting jobs still appear in reports but are not analyzed.

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

forge.comment: type: gerrit | github | gitlab. token_env: env var holding the API token / HTTP password. username_env: (Gerrit only) env var holding your Gerrit username — when set, Basic auth is used instead of Bearer. Required for OpenDev Gerrit.

feedback.comment: post_to_forge: post CI analysis summary as a comment on the Gerrit change / GitHub PR / GitLab MR. enable_voting: not recommended for CI analysis (informational only). Requires forge.token_env to be set.

log_scan_patterns.pattern: (No space left on device|Out of memory|Killed)

comment_log_scan: log_scan_patterns: regex patterns used to pre-classify log errors before the AI analyses them. Each entry needs 'pattern' (regex, case-insensitive) and 'category' (label string). Remove or add entries to tune for your CI environment.

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).
